name: CI

# Builds and tests of each change (Linux), also run before a release (release-on-tag.yml):
# - dependencies between the parts of the sources (tests/ci/check_dependencies.py);
# - editor built with Qt 6, and with Qt 5 (compilation only);
# - synth core alone, with ThreadSanitizer and AddressSanitizer (tests/synth_core);
# - plugin built, checked by pluginval, clap-validator and the test host (tests/plugin);
# - renderings of tests/render: modes of the editor and formats of the plugin compared with the synth core of the
#   same version, DLS import and export (tests/dls), and renderings compared with the previous version when the
#   sources changed (expected to fail when the sound is changed on purpose: listen to the renderings uploaded).

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

env:
  CCACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.ccache
  CCACHE_MAXSIZE: 500M

jobs:
  sources:
    name: Sources (dependencies)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Dependencies between the parts of the sources
        run: python3 tests/ci/check_dependencies.py

  editor:
    name: Editor (Qt 6)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: tests/ci/install_dependencies.sh editor

      - name: Restore the compilation cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: .ccache
          key: ccache-editor-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: ccache-editor-

      - name: Build
        run: tests/ci/build_editor.sh . build/editor && ccache -s

      - name: Upload the executable
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: ci-editor
          path: build/editor/bin/polyphone
          retention-days: 3
          if-no-files-found: error

  editor-qt5:
    name: Editor (Qt 5, compilation only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: tests/ci/install_dependencies.sh qt5

      - name: Restore the compilation cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: .ccache
          key: ccache-editor-qt5-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: ccache-editor-qt5-

      - name: Build
        run: tests/ci/build_editor.sh . build/editor-qt5 -DPOLYPHONE_QT_VERSION=5 && ccache -s

  synth-core:
    name: Synth core (${{ matrix.sanitizer }} sanitizer)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        sanitizer: [thread, address]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: tests/ci/install_dependencies.sh synth_core tests

      - name: Build
        run: |
          cmake -S tests/synth_core -B build/synth_core -DSANITIZER=${{ matrix.sanitizer }}
          cmake --build build/synth_core --parallel 4

      - name: Soundfonts
        run: |
          tests/ci/get_soundfonts.sh soundfonts
          python3 tests/render/make_test_soundfont.py soundfonts/polyphone-test.sf2

      - name: Stress test of the threads
        # Without address randomization: ThreadSanitizer does not support the mappings of recent
